scenes.name: Heed my call hero, and save Havenhythe from this terrible fate.
Their leaders will stop at nothing!
Stand with me against these ancient, treacherous creatures.
These monsters are the greatest danger my people have ever known.
They poison the very land with their lust for blood.
I know what lurks within it.
But the darkness may find them yet.
My people have no fear of the dark
magic sleeps beneath the earth.
Through gleaming rivers and ageless woods,
These lands are rich and team with life.
Farmers, fishermen, miners.
The people here are simple good-hearted folk.
Havenhythe is a peaceful place. 2
And with your help it never shall.
This future has not yet come to pass.
